technical_rules.A: close > SMA50 > SMA200 and close > 0.75 x 52wH (literal query)
technical_rules.B: close > SMA50, SMA50 <= SMA200 but SMA200 rising over 20 sessions, close > 0.75 x 52wH (secondary, flagged)
